title: Pullbacks measured
description: Level 2 upswings and downswings, each with its counter-move measured against the move before it. The pullback from 30,004 (20 Jul 00:00) came 50% of the way back towards 29,905; the one from 29,876 came 66% back; the next, from 29,905, went 124% back, past the previous pullback low, which is a market structure break; and the pullback from 29,985 (21 Jul 18:00) came 89% back to 29,781 over a day and a half. The bounces in the fall that follows read 67% and 30%. Each retracement is asserted at its deepest reading.
